title: Handling Objections
setup: You’re a sales rep running a discovery call with a potential client, Sarah, who’s evaluating software like yours.
prospectLine: Honestly, we’ve already looked at two other vendors who do this cheaper. Why should we even keep talking?
question: How will you respond?

choices.text: Well, we actually have more features than most of our competitors.
choices.intent: Jumps straight into a feature pitch without learning what Sarah actually needs.

choices.text: That’s fair. What’s been missing from what you’ve seen so far?
choices.intent: Acknowledges the concern and asks a curious, open-ended question to uncover what Sarah values.

choices.text: Price is one piece — let me show you our ROI calculator.
choices.intent: Gets defensive about price and pushes a value tool before understanding Sarah’s situation.
